meta.scope: Neutral index and human-review workflow for official commissioner public mailboxes.
meta.disclaimer: No message is labeled malfeasance. Automated flags are research leads only; full threads, employee reporting relationships, and legal context must be reviewed by a person.

reviewStates.label: Information request
reviewStates.meaning: Commissioner appears to seek information, which §2.2.J expressly permits.

reviewStates.label: Citizen referral
reviewStates.meaning: Message forwards or refers a constituent concern without an operational direction.

reviewStates.label: Possible operational direction
reviewStates.meaning: Language may direct an employee or agent; preserve the entire thread for human/legal review.

reviewStates.label: Insufficient context
reviewStates.meaning: Reporting relationship, quoted history, attachments, or surrounding thread is missing.

reviewStates.label: Reviewed — no §2.2.J flag
reviewStates.meaning: Human review found no reason to retain this message in the §2.2.J review queue.

signals.label: Direct-action language
signals.effect: Raises review priority; never determines the result by itself.

signals.label: Inquiry language
signals.effect: Generally lowers review priority because §2.2.J permits inquiry and information-seeking.

signals.label: Recipient and reporting chain
signals.effect: Confirm whether the recipient was under the direct or indirect supervision named in §2.2.J.

signals.label: Oversight and authorization context
signals.effect: Check whether the appropriate official was included, forwarded, authorized, or already handling the matter. Absence from CC is a flag, not proof.

signals.label: Complete thread
signals.effect: Earlier messages, replies, attachments, and quoted text can change the meaning; never classify an isolated excerpt as a finding.

signals.label: Money Trail cross-reference
signals.effect: Match vendors, consultants, developments, contract numbers, and named projects to existing records as possible research links only.

validationCases.label: Candidate thread 1
validationCases.note: Reserved for the first manually identified Burke email; no excerpt or conclusion is entered without the complete thread or direct archive link.

validationCases.label: Candidate thread 2
validationCases.note: Reserved for the second manually identified Burke email; no excerpt or conclusion is entered without the complete thread or direct archive link.
